title: toktier parity reading: the add_special_tokens=True column of one family
description: Per-family column of a native-front-end parity reading (CPU or GPU) for add_special_tokens=True. It compares Tokenizer.encode(t, add_special_tokens=True).ids with the reference oracle on the same documents as the parity pass. add_special_tokens=True means the post-processor of the reference document the reference route executes (the loader face). postprocessor_class is the facade's classification of that post-processor: identity (no token is inserted), prefix (one special-token id before the core stream) or reference (any other form, served by the reference route). served_by counts how each document was answered; on an identity or prefix face every document has to be answered by the facade (served_by.reference == 0), otherwise a silent fallback to the reference would read as zero mismatches. evidence_role states what the column shows: on an identity face it compares a core stream with a core stream and is a regression guard, not new evidence (regression_guard); on a prefix face it is evidence for the prefix rule (prefix_rule). loader_true_equal is informative and not a gate: the pinned loader's own object compared with the reference document under add_special_tokens=True on a few thousand strings. Checked by tools/check_reading_forms.py.

loader_true_equal.description: Informative, not a gate: the pinned loader's object against the reference document under add_special_tokens=True.

difference.description: none: equal on every string; fixed_affix: the loader adds the same prefix and suffix ids around the reference ids on every string; other: any other difference; not_built: the pinned loader cannot build its object for this family.
